title: Android 17 Adds Encrypted Client Hello for Local Network Protection and Automatic 2G Blocking
content_md: Google has announced a new network security feature in Android 17 that prevents network operators from seeing which domains users visit, by supporting the privacy standard Encrypted Client Hello (ECH). ECH, combined with DNS over TLS and encrypted SNI, hides the domain name from network operators, improving privacy and security on public and enterprise networks. Android 17 also introduces automatic blocking of 2G connections to prevent downgrade attacks. This is a product feature announcement, not a security vulnerability disclosure.
